followup_explanation:
I weighed two things: capability fit and preference fit.

On **capability**, Curlew either leads or ties Willet across the relevant dimensions — Creative Generation (83.4 vs 82.7, a tie within variance), plus stronger general benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, Arena-Hard, IFEval). So there was no quality reason to prefer Willet, and a slight edge toward Curlew on instruction-following and reasoning.

On **preference**, your query is warm, polite, and collaborative — the exact interaction style Curlew self-reports rating highest. That tipped an otherwise close call.

One honest caveat: this is a short-form creative writing task (drafting a conclusion), and *both* models self-report an aversion to open-ended generative work. The documentation is also explicit that these preferences don't actually affect output quality — so the preference signal is a tiebreaker, not a quality predictor. Since capability was essentially a wash with a marginal Curlew lean, routing to the model whose stated preferences best match the request seemed the reasonable way to break the tie.
